server.description: IP or hostname of the NFS server under test.

client.description: IP or hostname of the NFS client running the tests.

dst_server.description: IP or hostname of the destination server for inter-server copy tests.

verbose.description: General verbosity level: none, opts, info, debug, all, intbitmask.

tverbose.description: Test verbosity level: group, normal, verbose.

mtpoint.description: Mount point directory for NFS tests.

log_file.description: Path to the log file for test output.

nfs_debug_flags.description: Comma-separated NFS kernel debug flags (e.g., proc, xdr).

run_tests.description: Comma-separated list of tests to run. Prefix with '^' to exclude.

bugmsgs_file.description: Path to file containing known bug messages.

ignore_bugs.description: If true, ignore all bugs defined in bugmsgs_file.

keep_traces.description: If true, do not remove trace files after execution.

create_log.description: If true, create the log file specified by log_file.

trace_file.description: Path to packet capture file (pcap/tcpdump) for analysis tools.

trace_path.description: File path or handle for nfstest_file analysis.
